cases.name: Overlapping same-prompt sends from two workers
Own message remains selectable when sibling is absent
Sibling-only message cannot stand in for an absent own send

compilationTransform: Unchanged complete source compiled with appended test exports; Cucumber registration only replaced with no-op. Actual worker-scoped TEST_USER module and PostgreSQL driver used.
database: Local dedicated acceptance PostgreSQL, transaction-local temporary tables shadow only messages and agent_operations
limitations: Controlled database regression, not a full routed Web/Electron scrolling pass
Old CI lacks a selected-message/user receipt, so historical cross-worker selection is a demonstrated possible cause rather than proven historic ID attribution
workerIsolation: E2E_RUN_ID plus CUCUMBER_WORKER_ID controls TEST_USER.id; production CI uses E2E_PARALLEL=3 and each worker executes scenarios sequentially
